families.title: Model emits a tool that was not offered
families.invariant: Every model tool action is checked against the exact request tool set before it is persisted or dispatched.

cases.title: Correct an unoffered native tool before dispatch
cases.protects: An unoffered native tool receives one tool-free protocol correction and never reaches a tool handler.

incidents.symptom: A final model call emitted final_output as a native tool and the Run failed with TOOL_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
incidents.root_cause: Native tool actions were accepted as AgentAction values before their names were checked against the tools offered in that model request.

families.title: Paused queue head is shown as active preparation
families.invariant: A paused conversation queue has no watchable active head and the CLI must render its paused reason instead of Preparing.

cases.title: Do not watch the pending head of a paused queue
cases.protects: The interactive CLI avoids runtime lookup and watch startup while rendering the durable pause reason.

incidents.symptom: After a Run failed and paused its conversation, the next queued turn remained on Preparing indefinitely.
incidents.root_cause: The CLI treated the pending head of a paused queue as runnable and started a watcher even though no Worker could claim it.

families.title: Tool input violates its declared schema
families.invariant: Malformed model tool input is rejected with TOOL_INPUT_INVALID without exposing the submitted value.
matchers: tool value does not satisfy its JSON Schema

cases.title: Reject malformed input with a stable redacted error
cases.protects: Tool definitions validate canonical input and output schemas and do not copy invalid values into error details.

incidents.symptom: TOOL_INPUT_INVALID schema violations required a stable, redacted regression contract.
incidents.root_cause: The project needed one canonical boundary test for invalid tool arguments and safe error details.

incidents.symptom: A Web fetch used a malformed search_tool_call_id and was rejected with TOOL_INPUT_INVALID.
incidents.root_cause: The model supplied a value that did not satisfy the fetch tool JSON Schema; rejection was correct and belonged to the existing input-schema family.

families.title: Direct mode receives a tool action
families.invariant: Direct mode rejects every native or structured tool action as MODE_CAPABILITY_VIOLATION without executing it.

cases.title: Reject a native tool action in Direct mode
cases.protects: A Direct-mode native tool response fails with the stable mode-capability code before any tool execution.

incidents.symptom: A project-wide regression run showed Direct mode returning AGENT_ACTION_CORRECTION_EXHAUSTED for a native tool response.
incidents.root_cause: The offered-tool protocol check ran before Direct mode could apply its more precise mode-capability invariant.
